headings: # Altered States Can Deepen the Therapy

rows.label: Your P3, with 95.7 A's clause at the end of its first sentence
rows.start: And when the symptoms come and go randomly

beside.label: Your P3 before
beside.text: And when the symptoms come and go randomly, the best time to get diagnostics done could be right at the actual time of the crisis, rather than waiting until you feel well enough to make an appointment. But what if the attacks come almost every day? You can’t move into the ER. And normal test results don’t prove the pain is imaginary, just as a treatment that helps doesn’t explain what’s causing it.

headings: ### Opening up honestly to the right people at the right pace

rows.label: Your P3, with your 95.8 point after "I wouldn't even bother with that"
rows.start: So I’d ask them, before handing over any tricky specifics

beside.label: Your P3 before
beside.text: So I’d ask them, before handing over any tricky specifics: “What does the law require you to report?” That's a normal and expected question. Although personally I wouldn't even bother with that. You can always rephrase things as a dream narrative to get the emotional content across without triggering alarm bells (although I actually got in trouble with TalkSpace therapy bot even for a dream!). Just don’t hold back a danger that’s happening now from people who can help, and get anyone in danger safe before worrying about the rest. Sometimes telling on yourself is the thing that keeps someone safe, whatever it costs you legally.
